extensions.name: Dark Pages
extensions.description: Turns bright websites dark. Photos and video keep their real colours.
extensions.author: Yavqo

screenshots.caption: The same page with Dark Pages off and on
One switch in the toolbar popup

extensions.long_description:
Turns bright websites dark so they are easier on your eyes in the evening.

## How it works

- Flips the colours of the page, then flips photos, video and embedded frames back so they still look right.
- One switch in the toolbar popup turns it on or off. It applies to every site and is remembered on this Mac.

## Good to know

- It changes how every page looks, so it asks to **read and change data on all websites**. It never reads what is on the page and sends nothing anywhere.
- Sites that already have a dark theme can look odd. Switch Dark Pages off for them from the popup.
- Reload pages that are already open after you turn it on.

extensions.name: Focus for YouTube
extensions.description: Hide YouTube comments, recommended videos and Shorts so you watch what you came for.
extensions.author: Yavqo
extensions.long_description:
Watch what you came for.

## What you can hide

- **Comments** under a video.
- **Recommended videos** next to and after a video.
- **Shorts** shelves and the Shorts link in the menu.

## Good to know

- It only runs on youtube.com and only changes how the page looks. It doesn't read your account or watch history.
- Each switch is saved on this Mac. Reload YouTube after adding the extension.

extensions.name: Word Count
extensions.description: Counts the words on a page, or in your selection, and estimates the reading time.
extensions.author: Yavqo

screenshots.caption: Words on the page and in your selection, with reading time

extensions.long_description:
See how long a page is before you commit to reading it.

## How it works

- Open the extension from the toolbar to see the number of words on the page and in your selection.
- It estimates the reading time at about 230 words a minute.
- **Copy summary** puts a one-line summary on your clipboard.

## Good to know

- It only counts when you open the popup. It doesn't store or send what it reads.
- Pages that are already open need a reload after you add the extension.
